title: Home practical guide and safety card: exercise and pulse
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Working scientifically, revision through enquiry (Revolution)
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 6 (Home practical guide and safety card: exercise and pulse (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 6: Heart and lifestyle: pulse before and after exercise. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how exercise changes your pulse rate
safety: Stop if you feel dizzy or unwell
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Sit still for two minutes, then find your pulse on your wrist or neck
Count the beats for 15 seconds and multiply by 4 (beats per minute)
Do star jumps for one minute
Count your pulse again straight away
Rest, and count again every minute until it is back to normal

questions.q: Big question: why does your heart pound, then slow down?
questions.a: Muscles need more oxygen during exercise; when you rest the need falls.
